selection: First 2048 numbered MBA-class asteroids sorted by decreasing catalog diameter; biased incomplete subset, not a measured density field. Eros is a separate named near-Earth destination.

terms.data: NASA/JPL SSD public numerical orbit data; JPL attribution retained.
terms.delivery: One bounded server-side acquisition; local snapshot only. No browser request to JPL. API availability and data are not guaranteed.

model.disclosure: Approximate two-body motion from JPL osculating elements; perturbations omitted. Visible points are enlarged symbols, not asteroid size or density. Validity limited by policy to 180 days from element epoch; representative comparisons do not qualify every object or all times.

qualification.reference: Independent JPL Horizons geometric Sun-centered ICRF vectors, AU-D and TDB; four bodies at four epochs.
